title: Fly to Hong Kong, harbour night
cond: Sunny spells, a shower or two
call: Better than last night. JMA's latest track slows Champi's remnant: it's west of Kyushu on Monday afternoon and only reaches the sea near the Izu Islands, well south of Tokyo, by 15:00 Tuesday, as a weak 1004 hPa low, after you've flown. tenki.jp has Tuesday cloudy then sunny, 40%. There may still be some rain early as it approaches, so umbrellas for the 06:22 walk to Shimbashi, and check CX543 on Monday evening. Hong Kong: sunny spells, a shower or two, 26 to 30°, fine for the harbour cruise.
